hypothesis: Raw audio establishes how much the model learns without synthetic data transforms.
description: Attention pooling on original, unaugmented audio
success_criteria: Reference control; no standalone pass/fail claim.

hypothesis: Targeted augmentation lowers false-complete rate on pause/filler slices without collapsing recall.
description: Attention pooling with full Hinglish/pause augmentation
success_criteria: FCR improves on hard slices, recall drops no more than 2 pp, and overall F1 is not worse by more than 1 pp.

hypothesis: Mean pooling dilutes local endpoint cues and underperforms attention on pause-heavy slices.
description: Mean pooling with same augmented data
success_criteria: Attention wins by at least 1 F1 point on internal-pause or hard-Hinglish slice without material latency penalty.

hypothesis: Last-frame pooling is brittle when trailing silence separates speech from tensor end.
description: Last-frame pooling with same augmented data
success_criteria: Attention lowers internal/trailing-pause FCR while retaining recall within 2 pp.

hypothesis: Short-pause-only training fails on long hesitation.
success_criteria: Standard 100-800 ms range lowers FCR on internal-pause and Hindi-pause slices without >1 pp overall-F1 loss.

hypothesis: Long-pause-only training over-predicts incomplete after short natural breaths.
success_criteria: Standard range improves complete-class recall and overall F1 while matching long-pause FCR within 2 pp.

hypothesis: A frozen ASR encoder lacks task-specific endpoint adaptation.
description: Freeze all four Whisper encoder layers
success_criteria: Full tuning improves overall and hard-slice F1 by at least 2 pp; compare training cost separately.

hypothesis: Partial tuning retains most full-tuning quality with fewer trainable parameters.
description: Freeze first two Whisper encoder layers
success_criteria: Within 1 F1 point and 2 FCR points of full tuning on overall and hard-Hinglish slices.

hypothesis: Silence insertion, not generic augmentation, drives pause robustness.
success_criteria: Full augmentation lowers internal-pause FCR by at least 2 pp with recall loss no larger than 2 pp.
